newsitem.title: CHINA: China province '97 grain output seen at 30 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China province '97 grain output seen at 30 mln T.

text.p: China's northeastern Heilongjiang province is expected to harvest 30 million tonnes of grain in 1997, the China Grains, Oils and Feeds newsletter said in an edition seen in Beijing on Tuesday.

Output of corn and wheat in the province, one of China's biggest grain producers, was expected to fall by three million tonnes in 1997 compared with last year, the newsletter said. It did not give a breakdown.
Heilongjiang produced 14.45 million tonnes of corn and 3.30 million tonnes of wheat in 1996, official media has reported.
Production of soybeans and rice in the province was expected to increase by 2.5 million tonnes in 1997, the newsletter said.
The province produced 6.36 million tonnes of rice and 4.135 million tonnes of soybeans in 1996.
